mainTopic: Does חופה alone disqualify a woman who is פסולה לכהונה? The מחלוקת of רב and שמואל, the case of a girl under three, and רמי בר חמא's link to the משנה.
overview: The גמרא finishes a מחלוקת between רב and שמואל. רב holds that a חופה by itself, without ביאה, counts for women who are unfit to marry a כהן. שמואל holds that it does not count. שמואל adds that רב agrees with him about a girl younger than three years and one day: her ביאה has no legal meaning, so her חופה has none either. רבא backs this up with a ברייתא that lists all the legal effects of ביאה with a girl who is three years and one day old. From that ברייתא he infers that a girl who can be disqualified through ביאה can be disqualified through חופה, and a younger girl cannot be disqualified by either. Finally, רמי בר חמא says the main question of חופה לפסולות is the same as the argument in the משנה between רבי מאיר on one side and רבי אלעזר and רבי שמעון on the other.

steps.title: רב and שמואל disagree about חופה with unfit women
steps.stepSummary: רב says there is חופה לפסולות. שמואל says there is no חופה לפסולות.
steps.simpleTranslation: [רב said:] A חופה counts for women who are unfit for a כהן. And שמואל said: A חופה does not count for women who are unfit for a כהן.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes a מחלוקת between רב and שמואל. The question is whether a woman who is unfit for a כהן loses her right to eat תרומה just by entering a חופה with him.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב holds that the חופה alone has legal force. So a בת כהן who is פסולה לכהונה and enters a חופה with a כהן is disqualified from her father's תרומה. שמואל holds that only actual ביאה disqualifies her, and the חופה by itself does nothing.

keyTerms.meaning: The wedding canopy, meaning the act of bringing the bride into the husband's domain
Women who are unfit to marry a כהן, such as a גרושה or a זונה
There is, meaning it counts legally
There is not, meaning it has no legal effect

steps.whyThisMatters: This מחלוקת is the base for everything that follows: what gives a marriage-related act its legal power?

phrases.english: There is [significance to] chuppah for unfit women.
And Shmuel said:
There is no [significance to] chuppah for unfit women.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the מחלוקת that was introduced just before this point.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רב: חופה alone disqualifies a פסולה from תרומה. שמואל: only ביאה does.

steps.title: שמואל says רב agrees about a girl under three
steps.stepSummary: שמואל says רב agrees with him about a girl younger than three years and one day. Since ביאה with her has no legal meaning, חופה with her has none either.
steps.simpleTranslation: שמואל said: And אבא (רב) agrees with me about a little girl younger than three years and one day. Since ביאה with her does not count, חופה with her does not count either.
steps.whatsHappening: שמואל points to one case where, he says, even רב agrees that חופה does not count: a very young girl.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The reasoning ties חופה to ביאה with the word הואיל, "since." For a girl under three years and one day, ביאה has no legal meaning. So, שמואל says, חופה with her has no legal meaning either, and even רב agrees.

keyTerms.meaning: He agrees with me
רב's first name
A little girl

keyTerms.term: פְּחוּתָה מִבַּת שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וְיוֹם אֶחָד
keyTerms.meaning: Younger than three years and one day
Since
Marital relations

steps.confusionAlert: Do not think that שמואל is giving up his own view here. He is saying that רב, who usually gives חופה power, agrees with him in this one case.

phrases.english: Shmuel said: And Abba agrees with me
phrases.notes: "אבא" here is רב, whose real first name was אבא.

phrases.english: regarding a little girl less
than three years and one day old,
since she has no [legally meaningful] intercourse,
she has no [legally meaningful] chuppah.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Limits רב's view from Step 1 with a case where רב agrees with שמואל.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: For a girl under three years and one day, חופה has no legal effect according to everyone, because her ביאה has none.

steps.title: רבא brings a ברייתא about a girl of three years and a day
steps.stepSummary: רבא quotes a ברייתא. It shows that from three years and one day old, ביאה with a girl has full legal force. This implies that before that age it has none.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said: We also learned this in a ברייתא. A girl three years and one day old can become מקודשת through ביאה. If a יבם has ביאה with her, he acquires her. One who has ביאה with her while she is married is liable for אשת איש. If she is a נדה, she makes the man impure so that what he lies on below him is impure like the upper layer. If she marries a כהן, she eats תרומה. If one of the men who are פסול to her has ביאה with her, he disqualifies her.
steps.whatsHappening: רבא supports שמואל's premise, that ביאה with a girl under three years and one day means nothing legally, with a ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא lists every legal effect of ביאה: קידושין, יבום, אשת איש, טומאת נדה, eating תרומה, and becoming disqualified. It says all of these start at three years and one day. So below that age, none of these effects apply. That backs up the claim that her ביאה has no legal meaning.

keyTerms.meaning: We, too, have learned this, introducing a supporting source
She becomes betrothed through relations
The brother-in-law who performs יבום
He has acquired her as his wife
A married woman
The bedding beneath him becomes impure like the upper layer

steps.whatToRemember: Three years and one day is the age from which ביאה with a girl has legal force. Below that age, her ביאה has no legal effect.

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רָבָא, אַף אֲנַן נָמֵי תְּנֵינָא:
phrases.english: Rava said: We too have also learned:
A girl three years and one day old
can be betrothed through intercourse,
and if a yavam had intercourse with her, he has acquired her,
and one is liable on her account for a married woman,
and she makes impure the man who has intercourse with her
so that he makes impure the lower bedding like the upper.
phrases.notes: This is talking about when she is a נדה. It follows the rule of a man who is with a נדה (ויקרא 15:24).

phrases.english: If she married a kohen, she eats terumah.

phrases.aramaic: בָּא עָלֶיהָ אֶחָד מִכׇּל הַפְּסוּלִין — פְּסָלָהּ.
phrases.english: If one of any of the unfit men had intercourse with her, he disqualified her.
phrases.notes: He means men whose relations disqualify a woman from marrying a כהן or eating תרומה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supports the premise of Step 2, that ביאה below three years and one day has no legal meaning.
steps.raayaObject: The claim that a girl under three years and one day has no legally meaningful ביאה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא that sets three years and one day as the age at which all the legal effects of ביאה begin.

steps.title: Same age rule for intercourse and wedding canopy, proven
steps.stepSummary: רבא draws the inference from the ברייתא: a girl who can be disqualified through ביאה can be disqualified through חופה, and a girl too young for ביאה to count is too young for חופה to count. The גמרא accepts it: שמע מינה.
steps.simpleTranslation: A girl of three years and one day, who can become disqualified through intercourse, can also become disqualified through the wedding canopy. But a girl younger than three years and one day, who cannot become disqualified through intercourse, also cannot become disqualified through the wedding canopy. Learn from this.
steps.whatsHappening: רבא spells out what the ברייתא implies and closes the proof. The גמרא agrees with "שמע מינה", meaning "yes, we learn this from here."
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא only says that from three years and one day, ביאה counts. רבא reads it as one shared rule: ביאה and חופה go together, so where one has no legal force, neither does the other. This backs up שמואל's claim in step 2 that רב agrees about a girl under three.

keyTerms.meaning: She becomes disqualified (unfit for כהונה)
Younger than / less than
Learn from this, a formula confirming a proof

steps.whatToRemember: ביאה and חופה follow the same age line. Under three years and one day, neither one has legal force, and even רב agrees.
steps.confusionAlert: This proof does not settle the main argument between רב and שמואל. It only proves the one case they both agree on: a girl under three years and one day.

phrases.english: A girl three years and one day old,
she is the one who is disqualified through intercourse,
so she is disqualified through the wedding canopy.

phrases.aramaic: הָא פְּחוּתָה מִבַּת שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וְיוֹם אֶחָד,
phrases.english: But a girl younger than three years and one day,
who is not disqualified through intercourse,
is also not disqualified through the wedding canopy.
Learn from this.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes רבא's proof from step 3 by spelling out what the ברייתא implies and confirming it.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: For a girl under three years and one day, חופה has no legal effect, just as ביאה has none. This confirms שמואל's report that רב agrees in this case.

steps.title: Linking the canopy question to the dispute in the משנה
steps.stepSummary: רמי בר חמא says the question of יש חופה לפסולות is the same as the argument in the משנה between רבי מאיר and רבי אלעזר with רבי שמעון.
steps.simpleTranslation: רמי בר חמא said: on the question of whether there is a wedding canopy for unfit women, we have arrived at the argument of רבי מאיר versus רבי אלעזר and רבי שמעון.
steps.whatsHappening: A new teacher, רמי בר חמא, says the argument between רב and שמואל is not new. It matches an older argument already found in the משנה. This sets up the next move, where the גמרא will show how the two arguments line up.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Up to now this was a fight between אמוראים, רב and שמואל. רמי בר חמא claims the תנאים already argued about it: רבי מאיר on one side, and רבי אלעזר and רבי שמעון together on the other. If this is right, each אמורא simply follows one side of the משנה.

keyTerms.meaning: An אמורא who links the dispute to the משנה
A wedding canopy with women unfit for a כהן
We have arrived at the dispute, meaning this is the same argument as an earlier one

steps.whyThisMatters: Tying an אמורא argument to a תנאים argument shows both רב and שמואל have support in the משנה. This framing guides the rest of the discussion.

phrases.english: Rami bar Ḥama said:
On whether there is a wedding canopy for unfit women,
we have arrived at the dispute

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי מֵאִיר וְרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן.
phrases.english: of Rabbi Meir, and Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Shimon.
phrases.notes: This is the argument in our משנה. רבי אלעזר and רבי שמעון are together on one side, against רבי מאיר.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Leaves the age case behind and goes back to the main רב versus שמואל argument from step 1, linking it to the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The question of יש חופה לפסולות is the same as the dispute between רבי מאיר and רבי אלעזר with רבי שמעון in the משנה.
